arabic text: Gham-e Shabbir ki kandeel jalaaeh rakhna
english translation text: Keep the lamp of Shabbir's grief burning

arabic text: Bint-e-Zahra ko, nah hai ronay, diyan logo nai \nGhum ke daryaon ko aankhon\nGham ke daryaon ko aankhon sai, bahaae rakhna
english translation text: The people did not allow Zahra's daughter to weep \nKeep the rivers of grief flowing\nfrom your eyes

arabic text: Qatle mazloom, ko aaenge, chupane wale \nKhoon-e-Shabbir say pardoh\nKhoon-e-Shabbir say pardoh ko, hataae rakhna
english translation text: Those who try to conceal the killing of the oppressed will come \nKeep removing every veil\nwith Shabbir's blood

arabic text: Tum say vaada hai, ye Zahra kah, ye jannat teri \nHar jagah matami halko\nHar jagah matami halko ko, banaae rakhna
english translation text: Zahra promises you that Paradise is yours \nKeep circles of mourning established\neverywhere

arabic text: Jaate Shabbir, ne ro ro ke, kaha Zainab se \nMere Sajjad ko maqtal\nMere Sajjad ko maqtal se, bachaae rakhna
english translation text: As Shabbir departed, he wept and said to Zainab \nKeep my Sajjad safe\nfrom the battlefield
